## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:blocked`. **The silent-refused-write family's closing card:** every metadata write site surfaces a refusal, with an enumeration census

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-04T00:51Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Blocked-by: #11581

**Why blocked.** objectui#11581 (`pm:dispatched`) is in flight on `ObjectView.tsx`, which holds rows 1 and 3 of this card. objectui#11578 has closed, so #11581 is the remaining writer on that file. The unlock scan returns this card when #11581 closes.

**Measured now (objectui `origin/main` `f1c937966d`):** every row's log-only catch is still there.
- `ObjectView.tsx`: `:1510` (view config) and `:2280` (pin);
- `ReportView.tsx:188` (report auto-save);
- `RuntimeDraftBar.tsx`: `:135` (publish) and `:155` (discard).
- **One more site the table does not list:** `ObjectView.tsx:1464`, `'[ObjectView] Failed to persist view config:'`. The census picks it up, which is what the census is for.

**Why p2.** It is objectui#11578's grade, for the same class: a refused write looks saved. Row 2 also strands the edit, because Save disables once `isDirty` clears.

**Routing:** `packages/app-shell`, so `domain:ui`.

**Direction: the card's lead, confirmed, as the family's close.**
- Each site raises the refusal through the existing `toast.error` channel with `formatMetadataError`, as PR objectui#11582 did. ⛔ No new notification surface.
- `ViewConfigPanel.handleSave` clears `isDirty` and bumps `savedSignal` only after a successful save.
- **Acceptance, the enumeration census:** every call under `packages/app-shell/src/views/` to `createRuntimeMetadata`, `persistRuntimeMetadata`, `publishRuntimeMetadata`, `discardRuntimeDraft` or `dataSource.updateView` either surfaces a refusal or is ledgered with its reason. A new write site with no row turns the census red.

So this card's rows are all still log-only on `main` `b65aa5e`: `ObjectView.tsx` (`handleViewConfigSave`'s `persistRuntimeMetadata` near `:1525`, `handlePinView`'s `updateView` near `:2276`, and triage's extra `'[ObjectView] Failed to persist view config:'` site), `ViewConfigPanel.handleSave`, `ReportView.saveSchema` (`:182`) and `RuntimeDraftBar` (`:131`, `:151`).
  - The census population at `b65aa5e`: the write calls under `packages/app-shell/src/views/` are in `ObjectDataPage.tsx`, `ObjectView.tsx` (`:1101`, `:1525`, `:1568`, `:2226`, `:2276`), `ReportView.tsx` and `RuntimeDraftBar.tsx`. There are none under `views/metadata-admin/**`.
  - No open PR touches `ObjectView.tsx`, `ViewConfigPanel.tsx`, `ReportView.tsx`, `RuntimeDraftBar.tsx` or `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`. The in-flight claims (objectui#10202, `views/metadata-admin/**` and `plugin-designer`; objectui#11573, `packages/types`) do not name them. No new blocker.

## Seat review of PR objectui#11593 at head `69529b556` (dev report above): content ACCEPT for what it covers; one patch round folds the family's last measured site; then the at-tier contract review (`Clause-②: yes`)

`domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01FjqrwXPfSMkSfkKYDSRkN2` · 2026-10-04T04:22Z. Reviewed against GitHub, not the report.

- **Shape:** draft, base `main`. The first line is `Fixes #11583`, with no other closing keyword. `Clause-②: yes` is at line start, with its reason. 20 files, +1,484 / −22. `check-governed-merges`: NOT governed. The PR assignee is `os-zhuang`.
- **`Clause-②: yes`, confirmed:** `ViewConfigPanel` is exported from `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, and its `onSave` return type widens from `void` to `void | Promise<boolean>`. That is the case the claim named. The claim's `no` is amended here to `yes`, so an at-tier contract review is owed before ready.
- **Triage `5975148557`, carried out:**
  - Each write site's catch keeps its `console.*` line and adds `toast.error(t('form.saveError'), { description: formatMetadataError(err) })`. The sites are `persistViewPatch`, `handleViewConfigSave` (now awaited, returning whether the draft was staged), `handlePinView`, `handleReorderViews`, `ReportView.saveSchema`, and `RuntimeDraftBar` Publish / Discard.
  - The draft bar gets two keys in all ten packs, because its label table is objectui#10202's and has no failure keys.
  - `ViewConfigPanel.handleSave` clears `isDirty` and bumps `savedSignal` only when the host's save lands. Save is disabled while it is in flight, and an edit made during the save stays dirty.
- **The census** (`writeRefusalCensus-11583.test.ts`) derives its population with the TypeScript parser over every non-test source under `views/**`. Each ledger row is checked mechanically. It was red first on the six log-only rows, and a scratch write site turned it red by name.
- **Pins:** red first on `b65aa5e`: 12 failed, 19 passed (the controls). The objectui#11578 dev's 403 measurement reproduced through the real `ObjectView` + `ViewConfigPanel` + `RuntimeDraftBar` + `MetadataClient`. Ablating one toast turns exactly its pin and its census row red.
- **Patch round on this PR, before the contract review** (the family rule: an in-family site measured after the closing card was filed goes into the closing card, not a single-site card):
  1. **`ReportConfigPanel.handleSave`** calls `onSave`, `setDirty(false)` and `onClose()` before the save settles. The dev measured it after this PR's toast: the panel closed, and on reopen the edit was lost. This is the same shape as row 2, and the same direction applies:
     - the panel waits for the outcome, and closes and clears `dirty` only when the save lands;
     - a refused save leaves it open with the edit intact and Save live;
     - `ReportView.saveSchema` resolves whether it saved.
     - `ReportConfigPanel` is not exported from `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` or `views/index.ts`, so this adds nothing to `Clause-②`.
  2. **`handleSetDefaultView`'s toast** is the untranslated literal `'Failed to set default view'`, with no `formatMetadataError` description. Triage's direction says "with `formatMetadataError`", so bring it in line with its siblings.
  3. Both get a pin, red first. Re-run the narrowed union plus `check:i18n-*` on the final head.
  - **Claim `5976069786` amended:** the file surface adds `packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportConfigPanel.tsx`.
- **Acceptance notes:** `ViewConfigPanelProps.onCreate` stays typed as returning `void`, while the host passes `handleViewCreate`. That is harmless: create mode does not gate Save on dirty, and a refused create keeps the panel open.
- ⇒ `needs:contract-review` goes on the PR now. The isolated at-tier review runs on the head after the patch round.

Why yes: `ViewConfigPanel` is exported from `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, and the return type of its `onSave` prop widens from `void` to `void | Promise(boolean)` (written with parentheses here because the body sanitizer drops angle-bracket shapes). The widening is caller-compatible: every function a host could pass before still type-checks, and a host that returns nothing is read as saved, as before. No published schema, spec type or accept set moves. The patch round widens `ReportConfigPanel`'s `onSave` the same way, but `ReportConfigPanel` is exported from neither `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` nor `packages/app-shell/src/views/index.ts`, so it adds nothing to Clause-②: the `yes` is for `ViewConfigPanel` only. The at-tier contract review the claim names follows.

## What this changes

This is the silent-refused-write family's closing card (direction: triage `5975148557`). Every metadata write call under `packages/app-shell/src/views/` now raises a refusal through the console's existing `toast.error` channel with `formatMetadataError`, the way objectui#11578 did for the two Create View doors. ⛔ No new notification surface.

| Site (file › symbol) | Write | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `ObjectView.tsx` › `handleViewConfigSave` | `persistRuntimeMetadata('view', …)` | `console.error` only, not awaited | awaited; a refusal is a toast with the door's message, and the panel is told `false` |
| `ViewConfigPanel.tsx` › `handleSave` | calls `onSave` | cleared `isDirty` and bumped `savedSignal` before the save settled | waits for the outcome; clears and bumps only when the save lands; Save is disabled while it is in flight; an edit made during the save keeps the panel dirty |
| `ObjectView.tsx` › `handlePinView` | `updateView(…, { isPinned })` | `console.error` only | toast with the door's message |
| `ObjectView.tsx` › `handleReorderViews` | `dispatchViewPatches`, one `updateView(…, { sortOrder })` per saved view | `console.error` only | toast with the door's message |
| `ObjectView.tsx` › `persistViewPatch` (triage's extra site) | `updateViewConfig` | a toast only for the client gate's `ViewConfigPermissionDeniedError`; every other refusal, a server 403 included, `console.error` only | the gate's own message is unchanged; every other refusal is a toast with the door's message |
| `ReportView.tsx` › `saveSchema` | `persistRuntimeMetadata('report', …)` | `console.warn` only | toast with the door's message; returns whether it saved |
| `ReportConfigPanel.tsx` › `handleSave` (patch round) | calls `onSave` | cleared `dirty` and shut the panel before the save settled; a refused save lost the edit | waits for the outcome; clears and shuts only when the save lands; a refused save keeps it open with the edit and Save live; Save disabled and the inspector read-only while in flight |
| `ObjectView.tsx` › `handleSetDefaultView` (patch round) | `dispatchViewPatches`, `updateView(…, { isDefault })` | a toast with the untranslated literal 'Failed to set default view' and no reason | `form.saveError` with the door's message, like its siblings |
| `RuntimeDraftBar.tsx` › `handlePublish`, `handleDiscard` | `publishRuntimeMetadata`, `discardRuntimeDraft` | `console.error` only | toast led by "Publish failed" / "Discard failed"; the draft indicator stays |

- **Messages.** The object page and the report reuse `form.saveError`, as objectui#11578 did. The draft bar takes its labels from the metadata-admin engine table (objectui#10202's claim, untouched here), which has no failure keys, so two keys are added to all ten packs: `console.runtimeDraft.publishFailed` and `console.runtimeDraft.discardFailed`. They are read through a module-level hook (`useRefusalTitles`) whose `t` is bound to the packs. An aliased translator was tried first and measured invisible to `check:i18n-keys` and `check:i18n-dead-keys`, which classify `t` / `tt` bindings only: the two keys read as dead-key candidates until the hook landed.
- **Report save cadence (PM hypothesis 5), measured.** An inspector edit drives the live preview only (`handleReportFieldChange`); the write fires once per press of the editor's Save. So one refusal is one toast, no burst guard is added, and when the editor saves is unchanged. The pin counts the writes after three edits (none) and after Save (one).
- **Report editor (patch round, from the seat's review `5976535570`).** `ReportView.handleReportConfigSave` awaits `saveSchema` and re-seats the panel's config only on a save that landed, so a refused save keeps the open panel's draft. `saveSchema`'s no-client branch returns `false`.
- **A ratchet rebound to the handler (CI repair).** `view-filter-fold.ratchet.test.ts`'s explicit-save control asserted `handleViewConfigSave[\s\S]{0,600}persistRuntimeMetadata('view'`, a fixed window after the name. This PR's docblock and early return moved the call 708 characters after the name, with the call still there, so CI's `Test (shard 4/8)` went red at `e3c7e63`. The control now finds the `const handleViewConfigSave` declaration with the TypeScript parser and requires a `persistRuntimeMetadata('view', …)` call inside it: the same meaning, no byte distance, and a call in another function cannot satisfy it. The old window still matches at `b65aa5e` and does not at `e3c7e63` (measured with the regex itself).
- **Unchanged:** objectui#11578's toasts, `CreateViewDialog`'s await and objectui#11581's one builder; rename and delete, which already raised a toast with a pack key.

## The census

`packages/app-shell/src/views/writeRefusalCensus-11583.test.ts`. The population is derived by the TypeScript parser over every non-test source under the directory, recursively (`metadata-admin/**` included; it holds no write today): calls to the ruling's five names (`createRuntimeMetadata`, `persistRuntimeMetadata`, `publishRuntimeMetadata`, `discardRuntimeDraft`, `updateView`) plus `updateViewConfig` (triage's extra site), `deleteView` (`updateView`'s adapter sibling) and any symbol a `relays` row names (`dispatchViewPatches`). A site is keyed `file › enclosing symbol › callee`, never by line. Every ledger row carries a kind with mechanical evidence:

- `surfaces`: a `toast.error` call sits inside a `catch` clause or a `.catch(…)` callback of the enclosing symbol, and the row names a pin file that exists and names the symbol.
- `relays`: the write's promise leaves the symbol uncaught, and each call of the symbol is itself a census row.

The census is also red on a site with no row, a row whose declared call count differs from the tree, a stale row, a reason that says only "out of scope", an adapter write read off its object as a value, and a seam write imported under another name.

## Evidence

**Red first.** At `b65aa5e` with only the new test files added: the panel's 403 and 422 cases saw `toast.error` called 0 times (the objectui#11578 dev's measurement, reproduced through the real `ObjectView`, the real panel and its real draft bar, and a real `MetadataClient`); pin, reorder, the toolbar toggle's server refusal, the report Save, Publish and Discard saw 0 toasts; the panel's `false`, rejection and in-flight cases were red; the census was red naming exactly the six log-only rows (`handleViewConfigSave`, `handlePinView`, `handleReorderViews`, `saveSchema`, `handlePublish`, `handleDiscard`). Every control was green: `Tests  12 failed | 19 passed (31)`. After the change: `Tests  31 passed (31)`.

**Patch round, red first on the first round's head `69529b5`** (the new pins only): `Tests  5 failed | 23 passed (28)`. The set-as-default case: `expected 'undefined' to contain 'Setting a default view requires the M…'` (a toast, no description). The report editor through the real `ReportView`: `Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="report-config-panel"]` after a refused save. The panel's `false` and rejection cases: `onClose` called once; the in-flight case: Save not disabled. Controls green. After the change: `Tests  41 passed (41)` over the patched pins and the report panel's neighbours.

**Ablations**, from the committed head through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit once, blob changed on disk; restore proven by the HEAD blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`):

1. `handlePinView`'s toast swapped for `console.info`: exactly two cases went red, the pin case and the census's `surfaces` check naming `ObjectView.tsx › handlePinView › updateView` (`Tests  2 failed | 18 passed (20)`). Restored to blob `e24f9c5`, equal to HEAD.
2. A scratch view file `censusProbe11583Scratch.ts` with one `dataSource.updateView` call in a catch-and-log handler: the census's "every write site has a ledger row" went red naming `censusProbe11583Scratch.ts › renameQuietly › updateView` (`Tests  1 failed | 6 passed (7)`). The file was removed by its trap; `git status` clean.
3. The i18n gate reaches the new call: `t('console.runtimeDraft.publishFailed')` mutated to a missing key made `check:i18n-keys` exit 1 with `[missing-key]` on it. Restored to blob `405b57c`, equal to HEAD.
4. Patch round, from head `e3c7e63`: `ReportConfigPanel.handleSave`'s `if (!landed) return;` swapped for `void landed;`, so the panel shuts whatever the outcome: exactly three cases went red, the panel's `false` and rejection cases and the report editor's refused case through `ReportView` (`Tests  3 failed | 4 passed (7)`). Restored to blob `2500984`, equal to HEAD.
5. Patch round: `handleSetDefaultView`'s `description: formatMetadataError(err)` removed: exactly the set-as-default pin went red (`Tests  1 failed | 20 passed (21)`); the census stayed green, since the toast is still on the refusal path. Restored to blob `ec24e59`, equal to HEAD.
6. CI repair, from head `e075976`: the `persistRuntimeMetadata('view', …)` call in `handleViewConfigSave` renamed to an ablated callee: the rebound ratchet control went red with `handleViewConfigSave no longer persists through the metadata seam` (`Tests  1 failed | 8 passed (9)`). Restored to blob `ec24e59`, equal to HEAD.

## Verification at `e075976`

- Tests, the whole `packages/app-shell` suite, run under the verify lock in pieces that fit the foreground cap: `--shard=1/4`, then `--shard=2/8` through `--shard=8/8` (vitest's shard ranges over the 994 files: `1/4` is the first 249, `2/8` starts inside it, so together they cover every file). Each piece exit 0; summed: `Test Files` 1117 passed and 1 skipped across 1118 runs (124 files ran twice in the overlap), 0 failed (`Tests` summed: 10989 passed, 10 skipped). Plus every test outside `app-shell` that names `ObjectView`, `ViewConfigPanel`, `ReportView`, `ReportConfigPanel` or `RuntimeDraftBar` as text or reads sources from disk (35 files), and `packages/i18n/`: `Test Files  113 passed (113)`, `Tests  2727 passed | 13 skipped (2740)`.
- The gap CI found: the earlier narrowed union selected tests by IMPORT, and the ratchet reads `ObjectView.tsx` from disk with `readFileSync` and imports nothing from it, so the union could not see it. Shards 1, 4, 5, 6 and 7 at `69529b5` were cancelled by the next push, so it never ran there either. The whole-package run above covers that gap for `app-shell`.
